title: Reconcile installed capacity reserve and commercial headroom
reason: Current assessment — 2026-11-10, 00c3fe3. Partially resolved — assumption.finance explicitly defines forecast demand plus 5% good-output supply headroom, excluding extra forecast sales and permanent excess stock; tool protection is separate. The inherited 10% installed-reserve claim has no surviving target. Do not add it to 5%; any additional reserve policy and numerical capacity model still need an explicit decision.
